title: Error receiving too much data
symptom: The user reports that with a Huawei P30 on Android 10 and a Libre sensor, calibrations became very inaccurate and deleting too many calibrations or the ones the graph line is on causes the whole setup to fail. The error message 'error receiving too much data' appears and the app refuses to start up, even after reinstalling.
evidence_quote: I keep getting the error message that says 'error receiving too much data' and it refuses to start up.
